source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice mcqs written from Chapter 13 (PDF 1-11), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 13 (Thermoregulation and Osmoregulation) ke poore chapter se practice MCQs hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein. Har sawal ka aik sahi jawab hai aur saath mukhtasar wajah; numerical sawalon mein hal ke qadam diye gaye hain.

blocks.prompt:
1 The process by which living organisms maintain a stable internal environment despite changes in the external environment is:
(Woh amal jis se jandar bairooni mahaul ki tabdeeli ke bawajood andaruni mahaul mustaqil rakhte hain:)
blocks.explanation: Homeostasis (andaruni tawazun) woh amal hai jis se jandar bairooni tabdeeli ke bawajood andaruni mahaul mustaqil rakhte hain (13.1).

book_ref.quote: Homeostasis is a vital process by which living organisms maintain a stable internal environment

blocks.prompt:
2 Which group lists the important processes of homeostasis named in the chapter?
(Chapter mein homeostasis ke kaun se ahem processes bataye gaye hain?)
blocks.explanation: Homeostasis ke ahem processes thermoregulation, osmoregulation aur excretion hain (13.1).

book_ref.quote: Important processes of homeostasis are thermoregulation, osmoregulation, and excretion

blocks.prompt:
3 Homeostasis is maintained through the collaboration of:
(Homeostasis kin ke ishtirak se qaim rehta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Homeostasis teen bunyadi anasir se qaim hai: receptors, control centre aur effectors (13.1.1).

book_ref.quote: Homeostasis is maintained through the collaboration of three essential elements

blocks.prompt:
4 Receptor cells that detect changes in blood pressure are present in the:
(Blood pressure ki tabdeeli pehchanne wale receptor cells kahan hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Jild ke receptor cells temperature aur khoon ki naliyon ke receptor cells blood pressure ki tabdeeli pehchante hain (13.1.1).

book_ref.quote: receptors cells in the blood vessels can detect changes in blood pressure

blocks.prompt:
5 Specialized structures that detect changes in the internal or external environment and transmit the information to the control centre are:
(Woh khaas structures jo andaruni ya bairooni mahaul ki tabdeeli pehchan kar control centre ko khabar dete hain:)
blocks.explanation: Receptors (sensors) organs, tissues, cells ya subcellular hisse hain jo tabdeeli pehchan kar control centre ko khabar dete hain (13.1.1).

book_ref.quote: detect changes in the internal or external environment

blocks.prompt:
6 Which of the following act as control centres in homeostasis?
(Homeostasis mein control centres kaun hain?)

options.text: Dimagh, spinal cord aur endocrine glands

blocks.explanation: Dimagh, spinal cord aur endocrine glands control centres hain; muscles aur glands effectors hain (13.1.1).

book_ref.quote: The brain, spinal cord and endocrine glands act as control centres in homeostasis

blocks.prompt:
7 The control centre's messages keep the internal environment within a narrow range of:
(Control centre ke paighamat andaruni mahaul ko kis tang hadd mein rakhte hain?)

options.text: set points, jo jism ke kaam ke liye behtareen hain
ird gird ke medium ki qeematein

blocks.explanation: Control centres maloomat par amal kar ke aise paighamat bhejte hain jo andaruni mahaul ko set points ki tang hadd mein rakhte hain, jo jism ke kaam ke liye behtareen hain (13.1.1).

book_ref.quote: These set points are optimal for the body

blocks.prompt:
8 Effectors in homeostasis respond by:
(Homeostasis mein effectors kaise jawab dete hain?)

options.text: muscles ka sukarna aur glands ka ratoobat kharij karna

blocks.explanation: Muscles aur glands effectors hain: muscles sukar kar aur glands apni ratoobat kharij kar ke jawab dete hain aur set points bahal karte hain (13.1.1).

book_ref.quote: Muscles respond by contracting while glands release their secretion

blocks.prompt:
9 When body temperature drops below the set point, effectors in the skin and muscles cause:
(Jab jism ka temperature set point se gir jaye to jild aur muscles ke effectors kya karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Kanpkanpi (shivering) aur vasoconstriction heat barhate hain aur temperature ko set point tak le aate hain (13.1.1).

book_ref.quote: effectors in the skin and muscles cause shivering and vasoconstriction

blocks.prompt:
10 Regulatory processes in which the output of a system is used to control the behaviour of the system itself are called:
(Woh regulatory processes jin mein system ki paidawar khud system ke rawaiye ko control kare, kya kehlate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Feedback mechanisms, jo homeostasis ki bunyad hain, system ki paidawar se khud system ko control karte hain; in ki do qismein hain (13.1.2).

book_ref.quote: the output or product of a system is used to control the behavior of the system itself

blocks.prompt:
11 The most common form of regulation in the body is:
(Jism mein regulation ki sab se aam shakal kaun si hai?)
blocks.explanation: Negative feedback mein paidawar system ki sargarmi kam karti hai; yeh regulation ki sab se aam shakal hai (13.1.2).

book_ref.quote: It is the most common form of regulation

blocks.prompt:
12 Which of these is regulated by negative feedback?
(In mein se kis ka regulation negative feedback se hota hai?)

options.text: Shadeed sozish mein cytokines ka ikhraj

blocks.explanation: Negative feedback jism ka temperature, blood glucose aur hormones ka ikhraj control karta hai; paidaish aur clotting positive feedback se hain (13.1.2).

book_ref.quote: Common examples of negative feedback include the regulation of body temperature

blocks.prompt:
13 In the negative feedback control of body temperature, once sweating lowers the temperature to the set point:
(Temperature ke negative feedback control mein jab paseena temperature ko set point tak le aaye to:)

options.text: sweat glands aur paseena nikalte hain
thermoreceptors control centre ko paigham bhejna band kar dete hain

blocks.explanation: Paidawar (kam temperature) thermoreceptors par manfi asar dalti hai, is liye woh control centre ko paigham bhejna band kar dete hain (13.1.2).

book_ref.quote: As a result, the thermoreceptors stop sending message to the control centre

blocks.prompt:
14 If body temperature exceeds 37°C, the change is detected by thermoreceptors in the:
(Agar jism ka temperature 37°C se barh jaye to yeh tabdeeli kahan ke thermoreceptors pehchante hain?)
blocks.explanation: Hypothalamus ke thermoreceptors izafa pehchan kar hypothalamus ke thermoregulator (control centre) ko signal dete hain (13.1.2).

book_ref.quote: the thermoreceptors in the hypothalamus of brain detect this change

blocks.prompt:
15 A positive feedback system:
(Positive feedback system:)

options.text: system ki sargarmi kam karta hai
variable ko set point par rakhta hai
regulation ki sab se aam shakal hai

blocks.explanation: Positive feedback mein paidawar system ki sargarmi barhati hai aur asal stimulus ko taqwiyat deti hai; yeh negative feedback se kam aam hai (13.1.2).

book_ref.quote: In this way, the positive feedback enhances the original stimulus

blocks.prompt:
16 During childbirth, the hormone released by the pituitary gland that stimulates further contractions of the uterus is:
(Paidaish ke dauran pituitary gland ka kaun sa hormone uterus ke mazeed sukarne ko ubharta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Uterus ke sukarne se hypothalamus ko impulses jate hain jo pituitary se oxytocin kharij karata hai; oxytocin mazeed sukarne paida karta hai yahan tak ke bachcha paida ho jaye (13.1.2).

book_ref.quote: The control centre sends signals to pituitary gland to release oxytocin hormone

blocks.prompt:
17 Positive feedback often occurs in processes that require:
(Positive feedback aksar kin processes mein hota hai?)

options.text: tez aur bari tabdeeliyan, jaise khoon jamna

blocks.explanation: Positive feedback un processes mein hota hai jin mein tez aur bari tabdeeli chahiye, jaise khoon jamna, dard-e-zeh aur paidaish (13.1.2).

book_ref.quote: It often happens in the processes that require rapid and significant changes

blocks.prompt:
18 In severe inflammation or infection, unregulated positive feedback can lead to tissue damage due to proteins released by immune cells called:
(Shadeed sozish ya infection mein be-qaboo positive feedback immune cells ke kin proteins ki wajah se tissue ko nuqsan de sakta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Immune cells cytokines kharij karte hain jo immune response ko mazeed ubharte hain; be-qaboo ho to zyada sozish aur tissue ka nuqsan hota hai (13.1.2).

book_ref.quote: the immune cells release proteins called cytokines

blocks.prompt:
19 The maintenance of the balance of water and solutes in the body fluids is called:
(Jism ki raton mein paani aur solutes ke tawazun ko barqarar rakhna kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Osmoregulation jism ki raton ko bohat patla ya bohat gaarha hone se bachata hai (13.2).

book_ref.quote: The maintenance of the balance of water and solutes in the body fluids is called osmoregulation

blocks.prompt:
20 Osmoregulation is essential for:
(Osmoregulation kis ke liye zaroori hai?)

options.text: sahi blood pressure, organs ka kaam aur metabolism ka nizam

blocks.explanation: Osmoregulation physiological processes ke liye zaroori hai, jaise sahi blood pressure, organs ka theek kaam aur metabolism ka nizam (13.2).

book_ref.quote: including maintaining proper blood pressure

blocks.prompt:
21 The osmotic pressure of a solution is a measure of its tendency to:
(Kisi mehlool ka osmotic pressure kis rujhan ka paimana hai?)
blocks.explanation: Osmotic pressure mehlool ke osmosis se paani lene ke rujhan ka paimana hai; osmosis hypotonic se hypertonic ki taraf hota hai (13.2).

book_ref.quote: The osmotic pressure of a solution is a measure of its tendency to take in water by osmosis

blocks.prompt:
22 Osmoconformers remain, with respect to their environment:
(Osmoconformers apne mahaul ke lehaz se kaise rehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Osmoconformers paani aur solutes ki miqdar qaim nahi rakh sakte, jo medium ke saath badalti hai, is liye woh us ke isotonic rehte hain (13.2.1).

book_ref.quote: they remain isotonic to their environment

blocks.prompt:
23 Which of the following are osmoconformers?
(In mein se kaun osmoconformers hain?)
blocks.explanation: Osmoconformers mein tamam samundari invertebrates, kuch meethe paani ke invertebrates aur kuch samundari vertebrates jaise hag fishes, sharks aur rays hain (13.2.1).

book_ref.quote: Examples of osmoconformers include all marine invertebrates

blocks.prompt:
24 Osmoconformers are usually found in environments with:
(Osmoconformers aam tor par kis mahaul mein milte hain?)

options.text: nisbatan mustaqil solutes wala, jaise samundar

blocks.explanation: Osmoconformers aam tor par wahan hote hain jahan solutes ki miqdar mustaqil ho, jaise samundar ka paani (13.2.1).

book_ref.quote: Such animals are usually found in environments with relatively stable solute concentrations

blocks.prompt:
25 Animals that maintain constant internal concentrations of water and solutes despite a changing environment are:
(Jo janwar badalte mahaul ke bawajood andar paani aur solutes ki miqdar mustaqil rakhein:)
blocks.explanation: Osmoregulators paani aur solutes ki miqdar control karte hain; paani aur khushki ke aksar vertebrates osmoregulators hain (13.2.1).

book_ref.quote: Most vertebrates in aquatic and terrestrial environments are osmoregulators

blocks.prompt:
26 Which of the following is a mechanism used by osmoregulators?
(Osmoregulators ka kaun sa tareeqa hai?)
blocks.explanation: Osmoregulators namak ki active transport, namak jama karna aur paani bachane jaise tareeqe istemal karte hain (13.2.1).

book_ref.quote: active transport of salts, accumulation of salts, and water conservation

blocks.prompt:
27 Freshwater animals are generally:
(Meethe paani ke janwar aam tor par kaise hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Meethe paani ke janwaron ki jism ki raton mein ird gird ke paani se zyada solutes hain, yani woh hypertonic hain (13.2.2).

book_ref.quote: Generally, the freshwater animals are hypertonic to their environment

blocks.prompt:
28 The problem of salts faced by freshwater animals is that:
(Meethe paani ke janwaron ko namak ka kya masla hai?)

options.text: paani se namak andar aata hai
woh bohat namkeen paani peete hain
Na⁺ aur Cl⁻ jaise namak aur ions jism se bahar nikal jate hain
gills mein uric acid ke crystals bante hain

blocks.explanation: Zaroori namak aur ions jaise Na⁺ aur Cl⁻ bahar paani mein nikal jate hain; woh active transport se namak wapas andar late hain (13.2.2).

book_ref.quote: Essential salts and ions (like Na⁺ and Cl⁻) diffuse out of the body

blocks.prompt:
29 To eliminate the excess water that enters their bodies, freshwater animals:
(Jism mein aane wala zaid paani nikalne ke liye meethe paani ke janwar kya karte hain?)

options.text: bari miqdar mein patla peshab banate hain
rectal glands se namak nikalte hain

blocks.explanation: Meethe paani ke janwar bari miqdar mein patla peshab banate hain aur bohat kam paani peete hain (13.2.2).

book_ref.quote: For this purpose, they produce large volumes of diluted urine

blocks.prompt:
30 In hypotonic marine animals, excess salts are actively pumped out of the blood into the environment by:
(Hypotonic samundari janwaron mein zaid namak khoon se bahar mahaul mein kaun active tor par nikalte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Gills ke khaas chloride cells ATP istemal kar ke namak ko khoon se active tor par wapas mahaul mein nikalte hain (13.2.2).

book_ref.quote: specialized chloride cells in the gills use energy (ATP)

blocks.prompt:
31 Rectal glands of some marine fishes:
(Kuch samundari machhliyon ke rectal glands kya karte hain?)

options.text: faeces se paani jazb karte hain
namak khoon se nizam-e-hazm mein nikal kar faeces ke saath kharij karte hain

blocks.explanation: Rectal glands namak ko khoon se nizam-e-hazm mein nikalte hain jo faeces ke saath kharij hota hai (13.2.2).

book_ref.quote: Some marine fishes also have special salt excreting glands in rectum called rectal glands

blocks.prompt:
32 Hypotonic marine animals conserve water by producing:
(Hypotonic samundari janwar paani kaise bachate hain?)

options.text: bohat kam aur bohat gaarha peshab

blocks.explanation: Woh bohat kam magar bohat gaarha peshab banate hain; zaid namak kidneys se bhi nikalta hai (13.2.2).

book_ref.quote: They also conserve water by producing very small amounts of highly concentrated urine

blocks.prompt:
33 The impermeable outer layer of reptiles that prevents evaporative water loss is made of:
(Reptiles ki bahar ki na-nufooz pazeer teh jo bukharat se paani ka nuqsan rokti hai, kis se bani hai?)
blocks.explanation: Insects ka waxy chitin exoskeleton, reptiles ke waterproof keratin scales, aur mammals aur parindon ke murda keratinized skin cells aur tel ke glands hain (13.2.2).

book_ref.quote: Reptiles have waterproof scales made of keratin

blocks.prompt:
34 The Kangaroo Rat can survive entirely on:
(Kangaroo Rat sirf kis par zinda reh sakta hai?)

options.text: cellular respiration se banne wala metabolic water

blocks.explanation: Kangaroo Rat sirf metabolic water par zinda rehta hai jo cellular respiration ki zimni paidawar hai (13.2.2).

book_ref.quote: survive entirely on metabolic water

blocks.prompt:
35 A behavioural adaptation of many desert animals to avoid evaporation is that they:
(Sehrai janwaron ki bukharat se bachne ki aik rawaiyati adaptation kya hai?)

options.text: din ko zameen ke andar aur raat ko bahar

blocks.explanation: Woh din ki garmi mein zameen ke andar rehte hain aur raat ko nikalte hain jab hawa thandi aur nam hoti hai (13.2.2).

book_ref.quote: Many desert animals stay underground during the heat of the day to avoid evaporation

blocks.prompt:
36 Tardigrades (water bears) losing almost all their body water and entering a dormant state is called:
(Tardigrades (water bears) ka jism ka taqreeban saara paani kho kar ghunoodgi mein chale jana kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Anhydrobiosis mein tardigrades jaise invertebrates taqreeban saara paani kho kar ghunoodgi mein chale jate hain aur saalon baad paani milne par wapas zinda hote hain (13.2.2).

book_ref.quote: Certain invertebrates, like tardigrades (water bears), enter a dormant state

blocks.text: 13.2.3 Nature of Excretory Products in relation to Habitat

blocks.prompt:
37 In many animals, osmoregulation is coupled with the removal of:
(Bohat se janwaron mein osmoregulation kis ke ikhraj se jura hai?)
blocks.explanation: Osmoregulation metabolic wastes, khaas tor par nitrogenous wastes (ammonia, urea, uric acid), ke ikhraj se jura hai jo paani mein ghule hue kharij hote hain (13.2.3).

book_ref.quote: In many animals, osmoregulation is coupled with the removal of metabolic wastes from the body

blocks.prompt:
38 The volume of water needed to dissolve one gram of ammonia to a nontoxic level is:
(Aik gram ammonia ko be-zarar hadd tak ghulane ke liye kitna paani chahiye?)
blocks.explanation: Aik gram ammonia ko 500 mL paani chahiye; urea ko 50 mL aur uric acid ko sirf 1 mL (13.2.3).

book_ref.quote: One gram of ammonia requires 500 mL of water to dissolve it to nontoxic level

blocks.prompt:
39 Sponges and coelenterates, which excrete ammonia as their major nitrogenous waste, are called:
(Sponges aur coelenterates jo ammonia ko bara nitrogenous waste bana kar kharij karte hain, kya kehlate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Jo janwar ammonia ko bara nitrogenous waste bana kar kharij karein woh ammonotelic hain, jaise aksar machhliyan, protozoans, sponges, coelenterates (13.2.3).

book_ref.quote: Animals which excrete ammonia as their major nitrogenous wastes are called ammonotelic

blocks.prompt:
40 Ammonia is produced when the amino group (-NH₂) removed from amino acids and nucleic acids combines with:
(Ammonia tab banti hai jab amino acids aur nucleic acids se nikla amino group (-NH₂) kis se milta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Amino acids aur nucleic acids se nikla amino group (-NH₂) H⁺ se mil kar liver mein ammonia (NH₃) banata hai (13.2.3).

book_ref.quote: It is produced when amino group (-NH₂) is removed from amino acids and nucleic acids

blocks.prompt:
41 Ammonia is excreted rapidly because it is:
(Ammonia jaldi kharij kyun ki jati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Ammonia bohat zehreeli hai, is liye bohat paani ke saath jaldi kharij ki jati hai, jo sirf meethe paani ke janwar kar sakte hain (13.2.3).

book_ref.quote: Ammonia is highly toxic and so it is excreted rapidly

blocks.prompt:
42 One gram of urea requires how much water to dilute it to a nontoxic level?
(Aik gram urea ko be-zarar hadd tak patla karne ke liye kitna paani chahiye?)
blocks.explanation: Urea ammonia se kam zehreela hai; aik gram urea ko 50 mL paani chahiye (13.2.3).

book_ref.quote: One gram of urea requires 50 mL water to dilute it to the nontoxic level

blocks.prompt:
43 Terrestrial animals that convert ammonia to urea in the liver and excrete it through the kidneys are called:
(Woh khushki ke janwar jo liver mein ammonia ko urea bana kar kidneys se kharij karte hain, kya kehlate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Jo janwar urea ko bara nitrogenous waste bana kar kharij karein woh ureotelic hain (13.2.3).

book_ref.quote: The animals which excrete urea as their major nitrogenous waste product are called ureotelic

blocks.prompt:
44 In humans, uric acid is a by-product of the breakdown of:
(Insaanon mein uric acid kis ke tootne ki zimni paidawar hai?)
blocks.explanation: Uric acid purines (gosht aur kuch sabziyon mein) ke tootne ki zimni paidawar hai aur liver mein banta hai (13.2.3).

book_ref.quote: Uric acid is a by-product of the breakdown of purines

blocks.prompt:
45 Excess uric acid in the blood forms crystals in joints and tissues, causing the painful condition:
(Khoon mein zaid uric acid joron aur tissues mein crystals bana kar kaun si dardnak bimari karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Khoon mein uric acid zyada ho to joron aur tissues mein crystals bante hain aur gout (naqras) hota hai (13.2.3).

book_ref.quote: causing painful conditions such as gout

blocks.prompt:
46 Birds and most reptiles excrete uric acid. One gram of uric acid requires for its excretion only:
(Parinde aur aksar reptiles uric acid kharij karte hain. Aik gram uric acid ke ikhraj ke liye sirf kitna paani chahiye?)
blocks.explanation: Uric acid kam hal hota hai, tah-nasheen banata hai aur fi gram sirf 1 mL paani chahiye (13.2.3).

book_ref.quote: One gram of uric acid requires just 1 mL of water for its excretion

blocks.prompt:
47 The conversion of ammonia into uric acid by insects, birds and desert animals:
(Insects, parindon aur sehrai janwaron mein ammonia ka uric acid mein badalna:)

options.text: fi gram 500 mL paani leta hai

blocks.explanation: Yeh janwar urea bhi kharij nahi kar sakte, is liye bohat energy laga kar ammonia ko uric acid banate hain (13.2.3).

book_ref.quote: They convert ammonia to uric acid by using lot of energy

blocks.prompt:
48 Which group of animals is uricotelic?
(Kaun sa group uricotelic hai?)
blocks.explanation: Insects, sehrai janwar, parinde aur aksar reptiles uric acid kharij karte hain aur uricotelics kehlate hain (13.2.3).

book_ref.quote: The animals which excrete uric acid are called uricotelics

blocks.prompt:
49 Thermoregulation is the homeostatic process by which organisms maintain their internal body temperature:
(Thermoregulation woh homeostatic amal hai jis se jandar apna andaruni temperature:)

options.text: bairooni temperature se qata nazar qabil-e-bardasht hadd mein

blocks.explanation: Thermoregulation andaruni temperature ko bairooni temperature se qata nazar qabil-e-bardasht hadd mein rakhta hai (13.3).

book_ref.quote: maintain their internal body temperature within a tolerable range

blocks.prompt:
50 If the temperature rises well above the optimal temperature, enzymes:
(Agar temperature behtareen hadd se kafi barh jaye to enzymes ka kya hota hai?)

options.text: denature ho kar hamesha ke liye kaam chhor dete hain
sakht aur bhurbhure ho jate hain

blocks.explanation: Behtareen hadd se kafi upar enzymes denature ho kar hamesha ke liye bekaar ho jate hain; neeche enzyme-substrate takkar aur metabolic rate kam ho jata hai (13.3).

book_ref.quote: If temperatures rises well above the optimal, enzymes begin to denature

blocks.prompt:
51 Low temperatures affect cell membranes by making them:
(Kam temperature cell membranes ko kaisa bana deta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Kam temperature membranes ko sakht aur bhurbhura banata hai; zyada temperature par membranes apni selective permeability kho sakti hain (13.3).

book_ref.quote: Low temperatures can make membranes rigid and brittle

blocks.text: 13.3.1 Types of Animals on the basis of Heat Source

blocks.prompt:
52 Animals that gain most of their body heat from external sources are:
(Jo janwar apni zyada tar jism ki heat bairooni zaraye se lete hain:)
blocks.explanation: Ectotherms zyada tar heat bairooni zaraye se lete hain; un ka temperature mahaul ke saath badalta hai (13.3.1).

book_ref.quote: Ectotherms are animals that gain most of their body heat from external sources

blocks.prompt:
53 A lizard that is too cold sits on a warm rock. It gains heat by:
(Thand mehsoos karne wali chhipkali garam chattan par baithti hai. Woh heat kis tareeqe se leti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Ectotherms rawaiye se temperature control karte hain: dhoop senkna radiation aur garam chattan par baithna conduction hai (13.3.1).

book_ref.quote: If they are too cold, they bask in the sun (radiation) or sit on a warm rock (conduction)

blocks.prompt:
54 Ectotherms rely on heat from the environment because:
(Ectotherms mahaul ki heat par kyun inhisar karte hain?)

options.text: un ka metabolic rate bohat kam hai aur kaafi heat nahi banti
un par charbi ki moti teh hai
woh brown adipose tissue jalate hain

blocks.explanation: Ectotherms ka metabolic rate bohat kam hai; woh temperature barhane aur qaim rakhne ke liye kaafi heat nahi bana sakte (13.3.1).

book_ref.quote: In ectotherms, the metabolism rate is very low

blocks.prompt:
55 In very cold climates, ectotherms survive the coldest months by:
(Bohat thande ilaqon mein ectotherms sab se thande mahine kaise guzarte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Bohat thande ilaqon mein ectotherms sab se thande mahinon mein ghunoodgi (dormancy) mein chale jate hain (13.3.1).

book_ref.quote: In very cold climates, they become dormant during the coldest months

blocks.prompt:
56 When it gets cold, endotherms may produce heat by shivering or by burning:
(Thand mein endotherms kanpne ke ilawa kya jala kar heat banate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Thand mein endotherms kanpte hain (muscles ka sukarna) ya brown adipose tissue jala kar heat banate hain (13.3.1).

book_ref.quote: burn brown adipose tissue for heat

blocks.prompt:
57 Endotherms retain heat with insulation such as:
(Endotherms heat rokne ke liye kaun si insulation rakhte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Aksar endotherms heat rokne ke liye baal, par ya charbi ki insulation rakhte hain (13.3.1).

book_ref.quote: Most endotherms have insulation to retain heat such as hair, feathers, or fat

blocks.text: 13.3.2 Types of Animals on the basis ability of Thermoregulation

blocks.prompt:
58 Animals unable to maintain their body temperature within narrow limits are called:
(Jo janwar apna temperature tang hadd mein qaim na rakh sakein, kya kehlate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Poikilotherms temperature tang hadd mein nahi rakh sakte; yeh aam tor par mahaul ke mutabiq hota hai (13.3.2).

book_ref.quote: Poikilotherms are the animals that are unable to maintain their body temperature within narrow limits

blocks.prompt:
59 An advantage of poikilotherms over homeotherms is that they:
(Poikilotherms ka homeotherms par aik faida kya hai?)

options.text: kam ghizaiyat wale mahaul mein zinda reh sakte hain

blocks.explanation: Poikilotherms ko mustaqil temperature ke liye bohat khana nahi chahiye, is liye woh kam ghizaiyat wale mahaul mein zinda reh sakte hain jahan homeotherm bhooka mar jaye (13.3.2).

book_ref.quote: It allows them to survive in nutrient-poor environments where a homeotherm would starve

blocks.prompt:
60 Homeotherms trigger cooling or heating responses using a 'thermostat', which is the:
(Homeotherms thanda ya garam karne ke responses kis 'thermostat' se shuru karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Homeotherms (mammals, parinde) dimagh ke hypothalamus ko 'thermostat' bana kar mustaqil temperature rakhte hain (13.3.2).

book_ref.quote: They use "thermostats" (hypothalamus in the brain) to trigger cooling or heating responses

blocks.prompt:
61 On the basis of heat source and thermoregulation, humans are:
(Heat ke zariye aur thermoregulation ki bunyad par insaan kya hain?)
blocks.explanation: Insaan endothermic homeotherms hain aur negative feedback se jism ka temperature control karte hain (13.3.3).

book_ref.quote: Humans are endothermic homeotherms

blocks.prompt:
62 During hypothermia, vasoconstriction helps because it:
(Hypothermia mein vasoconstriction kaise madad karta hai?)

options.text: jild ki taraf khoon kam karta hai, is liye kam heat zaya
jild ki taraf khoon barhata hai

blocks.explanation: Vasoconstriction jild ki taraf khoon ka bahao kam karta hai, is liye khoon se kam heat zaya hoti hai (13.3.3).

book_ref.quote: Vasoconstriction reduces blood flow to the skin

blocks.prompt:
63 When tiny muscles at the base of hair follicles contract (goosebumps), body heat is conserved because:
(Jab baalon ki jar ke chhote muscles sukarte hain (rongte khare hona) to heat kyun bachti hai?)

options.text: jild mein khoon tez behta hai
khare baalon mein phansi hawa insulator ka kaam karti hai

blocks.explanation: Chhote muscles sukarne se baal khare hote hain; un mein phansi hawa heat ke liye insulator ka kaam karti hai (13.3.3).

book_ref.quote: Air is trapped in the erected hair and act as insulator for the heat

blocks.prompt:
64 Shivering is:
(Shivering (kanpkanpi) kya hai?)

options.text: skeletal muscles ka jhatkedar sukarna jo heat banata hai

blocks.explanation: Shivering skeletal muscles ka jhatkedar sukarna hai jo heat bana kar temperature barhata hai (13.3.3).

book_ref.quote: Shivering (spasmodic contraction of skeletal muscles) produces heat

blocks.prompt:
65 During hyperthermia, the thyroid gland may decrease the secretion of thyroxine, which:
(Hyperthermia mein thyroid gland thyroxine kam kar sakta hai, jis se:)

options.text: basal metabolic rate aur andaruni heat kam hoti hai

blocks.explanation: Kam thyroxine basal metabolic rate kam karta hai, is liye andaruni heat kam banti hai (13.3.3).

book_ref.quote: The thyroid gland may decrease the secretion of thyroxine

blocks.prompt:
66 Sweating cools the body because:
(Paseena jism ko thanda kyun karta hai?)

options.text: paseena jild ka khoon rokta hai
paseene ka urna jism se heat le jata hai
paseena baalon ki tarah hawa rokta hai

blocks.explanation: Paseene ka urna jism se heat le jata hai aur thandak paida karta hai (13.3.3).

book_ref.quote: Evaporation of sweat carries heat from the body and produces cooling effect

blocks.prompt:
67 In vasodilation during overheating, more heat is lost from the skin because:
(Garmi mein vasodilation ke dauran jild se zyada hararat kyun nikalti hai?)

options.text: epidermis ke bilkul neeche wali khoon ki capillaries phailti hain
dil muscles ko khoon bhejna band karta hai

blocks.explanation: Vasodilation epidermis ke bilkul neeche wali khoon ki capillaries ka phailna hai; in mein zyada khoon behta hai aur khoon se zyada heat nikalti hai (13.3.3).

book_ref.quote: It is the expansion of blood capillaries which lie just beneath the epidermis of the skin

blocks.explanation: Thermoreceptors dimagh ke aala marakiz ko bhi ubharte hain, is liye hum garmi sardi mehsoos kar ke naha lena ya pankha heater chalana jaise iqdamat karte hain (13.3.3).
